correctness.rationale: For each subgroup Gamma<=S4, equivariance reduces every Gamma-orbit of outer blocks to one representative. Consistency is exactly centralization of the representative's stabilizer, with the source's homochiral parity condition. This gives a finite product formula for Fix(Gamma). The three-cycle obstruction follows because a three-cycle fixes a weight-one block but its S4 centralizer is C3, containing no odd permutation. The complete 30-subgroup calculation, Burnside average, and subgroup-lattice Möbius subtraction are exact finite group arguments. The bundled verifier regenerates S4 and its subgroup lattice rather than trusting a stored table, and reproduces every stated count.
